tips.text: Claim it every year even if you own it; sell the extra copy and keep the free slot.
Use public matchmaking if the node is locked or the mission is awkward solo; the alerts are low level and others carry newcomers.
Check the event timer if the alert is not showing; it may not have gone live yet.
Open a support ticket right away if the reward never lands; the event is live for a short time.
Nobody treats it as a grind; the only complaint is finding out after the window closed.
